exposure: Mode of delivery in the first pregnancy
mode of delivery in women with preterm breech presentation
cohort: Women in the Netherlands with a preterm breech delivery and a subsequent delivery between 1999-2007
finding: In women with a preterm breech delivery, planned caesarean section does not reduce perinatal mortality, perinatal morbidity, or maternal morbidity rate over the course of two pregnancies.
mod_finding: Planned caesarean section does not reduce perinatal mortality, perinatal morbidity, or maternal morbidity rate over the course of two pregnancies in women with a preterm breech delivery.
